from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UndergraduateEnrollment(BaseModel):
    """Undergraduate enrollment data from one institution's report."""
    institution_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the institution")
    total_undergraduates: int | None = Field(description="Total all undergraduates count")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period/date, format YYYY-MM")
    report_year: int | None = Field(description="Year of the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    enrollment_records: list[UndergraduateEnrollment]
